card.name: Inside Lao script letters
card.fires_on: Individual characters inside Lao-script text, such as the national motto on the Laos coat of arms. Also fires weakly on a few partway-through-word pieces in other text.

modes.label: Lao script characters
modes.description: Single Lao letters or vowel marks within the Lao motto text.
